Resolves #20503

Related: #20498

Rewrites `learn/README.md` (Row 1 `learn-readme-door` of `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`) and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` (Row 9 `using-these-topics`) to open with the Two Hemispheres (`Body` + `Brain` joined by the `Neural Link`), provide direct entry paths for all three readers (developer evaluating the engine, enterprise evaluator, and human running a coding agent), map all 10 root sections of `learn/tree.json`, eliminate the banned over-claim register (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §2), restore `# Using These Topics` as the H1 and the `<details>` disclosure widget, replace the first `live-preview` code block (`Example.view.MainView` Button), and add a second `live-preview` code block (`Examples.functional.Counter` with `defineComponent` + `useConfig`).

Evidence: L2 (outside-CI live Portal Playwright verification on `#/learn/UsingTheseTopics` mounting both `Neo.code.LivePreview` blocks + static contract `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` across all 174 `learn/` files) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | Outside-CI static verification: verified Two Hemispheres opening (`Body` + `Brain` + `Neural Link`, naming the four workers `App`, `VDom`, `Data`, `Canvas` and VDom-worker diffing in `src/worker/VDom.mjs` → `src/vdom/Helper.mjs`), three-reader entry paths (including retained ADRs `0007`, `0008`, `0018`, `0029`), and all 10 root sections of `learn/tree.json` in `learn/README.md`. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI live Portal verification (Playwright headless Chromium on `apps/portal/index.html#/learn/UsingTheseTopics`): verified `# Using These Topics` H1, `<details><summary>Click here to see how disclosure widgets work</summary>…</details>` (`detailsOpenBeforeClick: false`, `detailsOpenAfterClick: true`), and both `Neo.code.LivePreview` tabs (`Source` + `Preview`) mounting `Example.view.MainView` (`"Click me!"`) and `Examples.functional.Counter` (`"Count: 0"` → `"Count: 1"` on click). |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI regex check: `0` matches on banned over-claim terms (`revolutionary`, `first and only`, `paradigm shift`, `unparalleled`, `unprecedented`, `groundbreaking`, `lightning-fast`) and `0` self-referential `"framework"` descriptions across `learn/README.md` and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`. |
| AC-4 | `git diff --name-only origin/dev...HEAD` verified only `learn/README.md` and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` are modified; `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` and `apps/portal/llms.txt` are untouched. |
